rationale: Human listening rejected multilingual Dragon HD Russian and selected MAI-Voice-2 for both languages. Native Russian uses Lev and Masha; English uses four native US English timbres. These are six engines shared by 22 roles, not 22 actors. Native delivery replaces the former pitch/rate profiles; unvalidated prosody controls are not sent or claimed. MAI-Voice-2 is preview. The previously released recording remains live until separate approval of this complete remake.
pronunciation_note: MAI-Voice-2 ignored the four-way IPA sentinel probes. The user explicitly selected natural delivery with targeted name/stress review instead of claimed phoneme enforcement. Display and synthesis text remain unchanged. IPA is listening-reference metadata only. Proposed fictional-name stress remains Mara, TO-man, E-lin, RA-ut, RA-dek, BE-ran, i-VE-ta; contextual homographs require separate listening. No old recording approval transfers to new audio.
